exposure: Excision of the cone in multiple specimens (multiple loop passes)
Depth of cone less than one cm
cohort: The study included 83 women with cervical pathology who underwent surgical excisional procedures (loop electrosurgical excision or cold knife conization) over a seven-year period.
finding: Positive endocervical margins, excision of the cone in multiple specimens, and depth of cone less than one cm were identified as significant independent risk factors for recurrence after surgical excisional procedures for cervical intraepithelial lesions.
followup_time: Median time of recurrence was 11.6 months, within a study period of seven years.
